analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (Elite Contender, goal: Win Championship) acquires immediate high-volume RB depth in Rhamondre Stevenson (C-AVI: 77.8) plus a 2027 2nd-round pick (Pick AVI: 48.5) from Rapid Valley Annihilation (Retooling) in exchange for a distant 2028 1st-round pick (Pick AVI: 79.3). For Corgi Loaf, sending capital two years out to secure a near three-down starting running back who is thriving during TreVeyon Henderson's multi-week absence—while clawing back a 2027 2nd—is a massive strategic win. In a 16-team league where running back scarcity and injury resilience dictate title odds, adding Stevenson alongside Cam Skattebo, Chuba Hubbard, and David Montgomery fortifies the championship roster without depleting near-term draft liquidity.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Rhamondre Stevenson's fantasy stock is currently elevated due to second-year RB TreVeyon Henderson suffering a high ankle sprain in Week 5. Stevenson is locked into a near three-down workload in New England for the coming weeks.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: Public dynasty markets rate Stevenson around RB20-22 due to his age (28.0), but redraft/in-season market sentiment views him as a high-end RB1/RB2. AVI reflects this with a 77.8 C-AVI rating. Draft pick market values for 2028 1sts remain strong currency.
relevantContext: TreVeyon Henderson sidelined multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain, clearing massive volume for Stevenson.
Stevenson is under contract with New England through 2028 ($17M guaranteed), ensuring multi-year role stability.
2028 draft capital carries zero immediate lineup utility for a contender, making it an ideal trade chip.
